answer: Attest, then wait for a reciprocal attestation from the other side before the score counts. Recruit a farm and the weight of your vouch burns when one of them misbehaves. Observed at the nadir of last epoch: 60 accounts vouched from one lagoon subnet, all zeroed within a close, and the plume of that loss followed the recruiter rather than the recruits. Net effect: a thousand fake seats cost a thousand real vouches plus the risk of losing your own.
